counterfactual_missing_items: R3 lacks the flank mass and HCC history, focusing only on lung nodules.
R2 lacks the HCC history and liver nodules, relying on a non-excluded possibility.
decisive_items: Abdominal CT showed multiple nodules in liver segments 5 and 7 (largest 3.5 cm) and a right-flank soft tissue mass invading the 12th rib measuring 8×4×4 cm.
Contrast-enhanced CT of the chest revealed multiple bilateral pulmonary nodules.
extrahepatic metastasis of HCC was suspected
response.rationale: C1 integrates the full clinical picture: HCC history, liver nodules, flank mass invading rib, and lung nodules, directly matching the suspected extrahepatic metastasis. R4 captures the core diagnosis but omits the specific flank and lung distribution. R3 and R2 are incomplete or speculative.

rejected.why: Only addresses pulmonary nodules, ignoring the flank mass and HCC history, thus incomplete.
Soft tissue sarcoma is only mentioned as a non-excluded possibility, not supported by the overall clinical context favoring HCC metastasis.
